## About
Blaine Quality Automotive & Tire is a full-service automotive repair and preventive maintenance center, family owned and operated, right on Central Ave NE in Blaine.
We work on all domestic and imported vehicles, using parts that are equal to or exceed the standards of the originals. We handle scheduled maintenance for your personal or company auto, pickup or truck, and you still keep the manufacturer's warranty.
We're also an authorized Intoxalock ignition interlock service center. Customers rate us 4.5 on Google from 122 reviews.

## Services
- Brakes and Traction Control: Brake and traction control repair for your car, SUV or truck.
- Engine, Cooling and Exhaust: Engine, cooling system and exhaust system work.
- Heating and Air Conditioning: Heating and air conditioning service so your vehicle stays comfortable.
- Steering and Suspension: Steering and suspension repair.
- Transmission and Drivetrain: Transmission and drivetrain service and repair.
- Starting and Charging: Starting and charging system repair.
- Tires: New tires put on and balanced. One reviewer said our mechanics pointed out a slightly bent wheel lip during the job.
- Intoxalock ignition interlock service: We're an authorized Intoxalock ignition interlock service center.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on imported vehicles?
A: Yes. We're qualified to repair and service all domestic and imported vehicles.

Q: Will servicing my car here affect my manufacturer's warranty?
A: No. Regardless of where it was built, we'll service your vehicle and you still keep the manufacturer's warranty.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.
